ssov_no_power: Your chosen stone has no power to call on.
ssov_freyja_used: Freyja has blessed you today. Her blessing returns tomorrow.
ssov_freyja_blessing_tooltip: You deal {0}% more damage, and each kill gives back {1}% of your health.
ssov_baldr_saved: Baldr's light turns the blow aside!
ssov_hel_mark_tooltip: Your max health and stamina are {0}% lower. Take your things back from your grave to lift it.
ssov_hint: As the runes fade, they point {0}. {1}
ssov_hint_none: The runes stay quiet. You have found every stone this world holds.
ssov_far_1: It is a long way off.
ssov_altar_desc: Bind the standing stones you have found here, each with an offering from its land, and choose among them at home.
ssov_altar_help: Bind a stone you have found with an offering from its land. A bound stone can be chosen here at any time.
ssov_altar_empty: You haven't found any standing stones yet.
ssov_kind_cost: Bargain stone: it gives, and it takes
ssov_tyr_lore:
He gave his hand to the wolf's jaws
that the gods might keep their peace.
Let you who read me learn the blade,
and pay what courage costs.
ssov_tyr_effect: Your melee weapon skills and Blocking rise {0}% faster.
ssov_bragi_lore:
The skald of the gods sings by the fire,
and the weary forget their weariness.
Rest a while, wanderer. The song is long.
ssov_frigg_lore:
She spins the clouds and knows every fate,
yet speaks of none.
The hearth she keeps is never cold,
but her steps are slow.
ssov_frigg_effect:
Food lasts {0}% longer.
Cost: you run {1}% slower.
ssov_freyr_lore:
Lord of rain and sunlight,
of the harvest and the catch.
He gave away his sword for love
and works the land with his hands.
ssov_freyr_effect: Wood Cutting, Pickaxes, Fishing and Farming rise {0}% faster.
ssov_ullr_lore:
He crosses the snow on skis of bone,
and his arrow never asks the way.
Let the hunter be silent,
and the string speak.
ssov_ullr_effect: Bows, Crossbows and Sneak rise {0}% faster.
ssov_hel_lore:
Half of her face is fair, half is the grave.
She gives strength to the dying,
and keeps what the dead leave behind.
ssov_hel_effect:
You deal {0}% more damage while your health is below {1}%.
Cost: if you die with her stone, Hel's mark takes {2}% of your max health and stamina until you take your things back from your grave, or a day goes by.
ssov_eir_lore:
Best of healers,
she knows every herb of every land.
Where she has walked, wounds close.
ssov_skadi_lore:
She chose a husband by his feet
and left him for the mountains.
The cold bows to her,
but it never leaves her.
ssov_skadi_effect: The cold and freezing hold you {0}% less, and you are resistant to frost.
ssov_heimdall_lore:
He hears the grass grow
and the wool on the sheep.
He sees a hundred leagues by night.
Nothing comes for you unseen.
ssov_heimdall_effect: Enemies coming for you within {0} m show on your minimap.
ssov_thor_lore:
He carries the hammer no giant can lift,
and the burden of Midgard besides.
Let your back be as strong as his.
ssov_thor_effect: Your max carry weight rises by {0}.
ssov_baldr_lore:
All things swore never to harm him,
but one was forgotten.
Once each day his light
turns aside the blow that would end you.
ssov_baldr_effect: Once a day, a blow that would kill you leaves you at {0}% health instead, and nothing can hurt you for {1} seconds.
ssov_odin_lore:
Nine nights he hung on the windswept tree,
wounded with a spear, given to himself,
and took up the runes.
ssov_odin_effect: Elemental Magic and Blood Magic rise {0}% faster.
ssov_freyja_lore:
Lady of the slain,
she takes half of all who fall.
Once each day she rides beside you,
and the fallen feed your strength.
ssov_freyja_effect: Once a day, call on her blessing: for {2} seconds you deal {0}% more damage, and each kill gives back {1}% of your health.
ssov_loki_lore:
Friend and foe of the gods,
he wears a hundred faces.
He will teach you to strike unseen,
but every trick has its price.
ssov_loki_effect:
Your sneak attacks hit {0}% harder, and you are {1}% quieter while sneaking.
Cost: your max health is {2}% lower.
ssov_vidarr_lore:
The silent god. His shoe is made
of every scrap the cobblers cut away.
At the end he will tear the wolf's jaws apart.
He strikes. He does not shield.
ssov_vidarr_effect:
Your melee attacks deal {0}% more damage.
Cost: your block power is {1}% lower.
ssov_njord_lore:
Lord of the wind and the shore,
of ships and of the catch.
He calms the sea
for those who honour him.
ssov_njord_effect: A ship you steer sails {0}% faster, and swimming costs {1}% less stamina.
